expected_execution_change: With R02, V00, and the fixed dose, the only changed factor is the retained point count (20 -> 12). The half-window aggregate loss is evaluated over the A12 atom_slots [0,1,2,3,6,12,13,17,18,20,21,22] instead of the L109 set, so the per-step coordinate update direction is computed from fewer surrounding points while the typed slots 12 and 22 and their neighbors remain in the support. The expected measurable response is a change in the generated-parent layout/affinity metrics relative to the L109 measured reference (mean 7.7836, best_qualified 8.4339), with the typed C12/N22 slots and the VAL:116:N anchor still present in the generated output. Quality side effects to report include any loss of the typed slots or anchor, and any change in terminal affinity or coordinate quality.
falsifier: Run the fixed R02/V00 generation on A12 and measure the generated-parent score against the L109 measured reference (mean 7.7836, best_qualified 8.4339). The hypothesis is falsified if A12's measured generated-parent score does not improve on or match that reference, or if the generated output fails to retain typed slots 12 (C) and 22 (N), their neighbor sets [18,21] and [6,13], or the VAL:116:N anchor. A further falsifier is that the reduced support produces no measurable change in the generated-parent metrics relative to L109, which would indicate the removed points were not contributing to the applied update. These are measured execution and terminal-output criteria; the static source layout_score is not used as evidence either way.
scientific_rationale: V00 is the only legal variant and it is numerically live: weights.half=1.0 with endpoint/type/orientation all 0.0, so the sole enabled term is the half-window aggregate layout loss over the declared window [0.1,0.5]. The Analyst's hypothesis is a support-set change, not a controller change: A12 keeps the same template F_b011_s030_native, node single_b011_final_030, typed_slots [12,22] (C,N), their role neighbors [18,21] and [6,13], and the VAL:116:N anchor (teacher_match_strength 0.9511), while reducing retained local points from L109's 20 to 12. Because the half term is an aggregate over the retained point set, shrinking the set changes which pointwise forces enter the aggregate and therefore the direction of the accumulated coordinate update; it does not rescale a normalized mixture, so the effect is a genuine change in the applied geometry rather than a cancellation. The dose is separately fixed (max_atom_step_A 0.15, max_cumulative_rms_A 6.0, native_rms_ratio 0.66, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0) and is not altered by this choice, so any observed difference is attributable to the support set and not to a dose change. The source layout_score 8.704859 is a teacher layout score for the source input and is not a forecast for newly generated samples; the comparison reference is the measured generated-parent L109 result (mean 7.7836, best_qualified 8.4339). No affinity gradient is introduced, no particle resampling is used, and no claim is made that geometric matching proves binding.
